author: HartOve

notes: Blue street blade on a lamp post, Tallinn, seen from below against a cloudy sky; 'pst' abbreviates 'puiestee' (boulevard). Formerly part of Moskva puiestee. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Minnekon
attribution: Photo: Minnekon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alkopealinn.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Advance direction sign on Tartu maantee entering Valga, at the left of a cycle path, mid distance; route shields 3, E 264, 6, 49. The alcohol-shop billboards on the right (ALKO 1000 MARKET, SuPer Alko 'Raiņa 3, Valka', ALKO SHOP) are advertising distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Wiki Asmah
attribution: Photo: Wiki Asmah, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kalamaja,_Tallinn_20260802_-_08.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

Two arms are partly hidden behind others: one ends '...ääs Muuseumisse / ...eum entrance', another 'Meremuuse[um] / The Mus[...]'; those partial arms are not transcribed. Car number plates in the lot are incidental.

author: Toomas123
